context:
Goal: the lost merge-tool change you remember lands, so a fix check no longer needs an extra Sonnet round or a hand-off when a PR already holds other records.
Problem (rule): making the coordinator's red test pass changes line 134 of decision pr-review-record ("HEAD must be the Head of the newest earlier record on the PR"), which carries no owner tag, and a change that departs from a ruling goes to you before it is built.
Based on (read): line 134 and line 137 of docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md on origin/main (read 10:35 CST); line 137 (your 20:01 CST Nov 17 ruling that an older head is accepted for a merge only when it is an ancestor of the newest head and its record reads done) reaches only a merge head, not an older plain head.
Based on (read): the coordinator's red case on branch fix-check-other-records (merge/test_merge.py, class ReviewFixBase) fails with "a fix check naming an older record's head ... was refused"; the subtest at merge/test_merge.py line 18136 pins the current rule.
Departs from: docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md line 134 — the fix check must name the newest record's head — a fix check may name an older reviewed head that has its own record.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the coordinator builds option a now and you can narrow it to c before it merges.

options.gain: The lost work lands as you remember it.
options.how: Line 134 changes as the step says: a head with a record is accepted, a head with no record still refuses.
options.label: Accept any reviewed head that has its own record (default being built, recommended)
options.lose: The merge check accepts more heads; the change owes the net-value test if it reaches round 3.

options.how: No change to the merge tool; the step closes.
options.label: Keep line 134, drop the case and close the step

options.gain: Most of the step, with the same safety test you ruled on Nov 17.
options.how: Your Nov 17 ancestry rule, now for merge heads, is extended to plain heads.
options.label: Accept only an older reviewed head that is an ancestor of the newest head and whose record reads done (narrower)
options.lose: A head on a rebased or unrelated line still refuses.

reply: Closed. You picked a (accept any reviewed head that has its own record). Routed to the coordinator, who confirmed at 11:07 CST it is building a as planned under step fix-check-other-records.

title: May the merge tool accept a fix check that names an older reviewed head, instead of the newest record's head?
why: The coordinator and the consultant found that the newest-only rule rests on a consultant pick of 15:05 CST Nov 15, not on your ruling, so a lands your lost work fast, as you asked at 10:15 CST; c narrows it and costs more build time. Recommended by the coordinator, relayed, not owner-typed.
